dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit jagged, high-intensity perimeters. These rings show a sharp gradient transition from the dark base fur into fragmented, light-colored outer bands with darker interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of asymmetrical light-pixel clusters primarily localized along the ventral-lateral margin and distal tail section, appearing as solid concentrations without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent circular patterns on the mid-lateral flank form an irregular scalene quadrilateral with the longest axis parallel to the dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent reddish-brown textured lesion with irregular margins is visible at the posterior terminus, contrasting sharply in color and pixel intensity from the surrounding fur.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, elongated, zig-zagging band of high-intensity pixels extends diagonally across the upper dorsal-lateral region, distinct from the circular annuli patterns.
